notes.title: Minor update to version 1.03: main menu polish, esthetic and gameplay fixes.
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.03 of Orb and the Stars corrects esthetic and gameplay issues:[/b]

Main Menu polishing:
[list]
[*] Added images for last worlds in level selection menus
[*] Buttons are now scaled correctly on lower resolutions
[*] Corrected remaining star shards not appearing properly on the levels list
[*] New buttons for saved games, showing chosen custom orb and flags
[*] Fixed sounds repeating when navigating with the mouse[/list]

And also:
[list] 
[*]Fixed: chosen flag and orb skins were not loaded correctly (on game startup and on saved game change)
[*]New option to select another save file from the main menu
[*]In Argo Navis 2, player can no longer be stuck after falling on, the lower ground.
[*]Added dialog lines in Crater 2
[*]Added dialog lines on the main menu when the last level is completed.
[*]Corrected some mistakes in the game's text
[*]Corrected sprite for "E" key, which was too big.
[*]Fixed: the game could continue playing behind the Game Over Screen
[*]Corvus' Boss fight adjustements and corrections, such as: enemy can no longer take damage when attacking, death animation fixed...[/list]

Enjoy the game and have a nice summer!

notes.title: Orb and the Stars minor update for 6 July 2021
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.02[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed splash and start-up screen (too much wait on Cataire Studios' logo and too much wait on a black screen when loading the start menu, now there's an orb-progress-bar).
[*]Corrections on Centaurus: some star shards never appeared on level 1.
[*]Corrections on Centaurus: esthetic changes for mecanisms to make it more clear everywhere.
[*]Corrections on Centaurus: rotative elements were affected by CPU speed, now they're equivalent on any computer.[/list]

Have a nice roll!

notes.title: Orb and the Stars is released today!
notes.notes:
After some waiting and two postpones, at last you can play the first game of Cataire Studios!

The whole game is playable and you can start to travel through the constellations right now. 
But please consider that our most recent testing proved that some improvements are still necessary, so you can expect to see some patching very soon.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882708/9988616aaf1c5ae2852474fd0962c66b49e2801a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882708/c0ab08166e62fa01398157a2a72497ca98b0db96.png[/img][/url]


Thanks by advance for playing Orb and the Stars, and sorry for any inconvenience you may have. Please don't hesitate to send a message to the support if you encounter any issue with the game, they will be addressed as quickly as possible.

Anyway, I hope you'll enjoy this stellar story!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - 10th October
notes.notes:
Hello all, and thanks for your interest in Orb & the Stars demo!
Following some feedback, this new updates contains the following fixes:

[list]
[*]Automatically adds game version in the player log.
[*]Fixed Launcher/catapult anomaly (Sometimes, the catapult was disabled, making it impossible to complete the level).
[*]Fixed: Bug on lives: they were always staying black even when replenished at the start of a level.
[*]Fixed: "Retry this level" button in the "level complete" screen (it was binded to the main menu instead of the retry function).
[*]Tutorial: Fixed the black pusher area of action so it can push the orb even if it's too far.
[*]Canis Major level 1: Fixed a glitch when the player could be stuck before the bridge at the end of the level.
[*]Canis Major level 2: the death zone in the water didn't cover all the water (the player could be stuck at this point).
[*]Minor graphical improvements.[/list]

Please, don't hesitate to tell me if you run into any more problems!

Good luck helping Sirius!

notes.title: Orb & the Stars: help Sirius now, in this 20 minutes demo!
notes.notes:
Cataire Studios is proud to announce its first game: Orb & the Stars!
The game is set to be released on december this year. In the meantime, please enjoy this short demo!


In this demo, after a short tutorial, you will travel to [b]Canis Major, the constellation of the Great Dog[/b], in order to help Sirius to solve three problems:
[olist]
[*]The stars have vanished... You need to [b]complete the levels[/b] to rekindle them!
[*]Sirius the dog is the brightest star of Canis Major, but his powers are depleted. [b]Collect all the star fragments[/b] to allow him to recover all his powers.
[*]Once this is all done, you will need to [b]fight the creature[/b] responsible for this chaos, with the help of your new friend.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882708/6adcdaf44acba3fbee569d4a0a27319c210ce566.png[/img]

This first glimpse at the game will allow you to understand the concept of Orb & the Stars, and if it pleases you, feel free to add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss its release in december!

[b][i]The whole game is playable with a controller or a keyboard.[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882708/7f5bb64812c1c72e4143e57870df3400622d1d42.png[/img]
